comparison.objective: Remove a screwdriver, latch a control box and energize it safely; candidate sorts moving cartons by closure state.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2245 tests tool extraction, hinged-cover closure, catch latching and rocker switching in a safety sequence. Candidate tests moving interception, sidewall grasping around flaps and spill-free transport.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2245 requires the released stable tool outside, shut latched cover, supply on and hands clear; unsafe energization is permanently invalidating. Candidate requires carton-specific reject/pass results and retained contents.
comparison.reason: Safe machine re-energization and enclosure closure do not duplicate the candidate's manipulation or outcome.
